title: Online task offer and top-up requests — synthetic demo
rawChat:
[08/10/2026, 09:10] Demo Admin: We offer tasks that involve liking posts, with a promised commission of IDR 50,000 per day.
[08/10/2026, 09:14] Demo Admin: To continue the tasks, please pay a deposit of IDR 180,000 to DEMO-ACCOUNT-001.
[08/10/2026, 09:28] Demo User: I have just sent IDR 180,000. I have not recorded the transfer time yet.
[08/10/2026, 09:35] Demo Admin: Now add a deposit of IDR 420,000 so the balance can be withdrawn.
[08/10/2026, 09:40] Demo User: The additional deposit is still pending. I have not seen the transaction on my bank statement.

transfers.note: Transfer date not recorded; do not use the message timestamp.
